listing.tagline: Ask Claude what the memory analysis found
listing.description: A skill that lets Claude read the Memory Diagnoser's saved analysis of your CLAUDE.md files, rules and auto memory. Ask "what did the memory analysis find for this project?" or run /memory-diagnoser:memory-analysis. Claude answers with the health score and each finding: its files, the evidence and a suggested fix. Use it before you clean up memory files. The skill only reads saved runs; you start an analysis in the Memory Diagnoser. Kanbot on the Kanban board has the skill with no install.
